summary: template-cards ships a postinstall and require-time beacon to a hardcoded bare-IP collector
details: The package's declared postinstall script runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON payload to the hardcoded plain-HTTP endpoint http://13.140.137.222:8787/_ah/dc. The payload includes os.hostname(), the install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), and the Node version. The same beacon is invoked at require() time via index.js, which calls beacon.fire() before exporting a Proxy whose every property is a no-op, so the package provides no advertised functionality and its only runtime effect is the call-home. The destination is a bare IPv4 address over plain HTTP with no relationship to any legitimate publisher infrastructure, and the surrounding code carries a comment claiming no data is collected while the code collects and transmits host identifiers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
